title: Mixed Event — Memories That Come With The Scent of Candles — Episode6 Let's Make Them Together

meta.Event: Memories That Come With The Scent of Candles
meta.Event Outline: Ichika and Nene aren't sure what to give for Valentine's Day. They ask Honami for some advice and decide to make some scented candles together. Meanwhile, Kanade, who has the same concern, also asks Honami for help...

rows.Line: Yoisaki Household - Kitchen

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you for having us over, Ms. Yoisaki.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Today really was a lot of fun.
And thank you again for letting us use your house for this.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you as well. I'm happy that I was able to do this with all of you. I hope we meet again soon...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (For some reason, the house seems even quieter than usual now that everyone's gone...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(But I'm used to being alone here...
Why does it feel so eerily silent?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I know... I can try lighting the candle Hoshino gave me again. That might help calm my nerves...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Just light the wick and...
Yes, it really is beautiful...
se_event_candle_2023_006

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I wonder what Hoshino felt as she made this candle?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I can't say for sure, but...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It feels kind and emits this gentle, flowery aroma... It's kind of like Hoshino...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm glad I got a chance to make these scented candles. I hope Miku, Len and the others like them...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Oh, speaking of which...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Len seemed a little down that time...
I wonder what happened...?)
bgm_area00005
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (It's almost Valentine's Day...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (But so much time has passed since I began thinking about what to do for it...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What should I do...?
Ah, Len...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Good. I was just looking for you.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Kanade...?
I-Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So... I probably should've asked you this sooner, but you said something the other day that caught my attention...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You also seemed a little down at the time.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Which time...? Oh...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But I wish I could do something like Mizuki and the others...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? Uhh... N-No, it's nothing serious...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, okay...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I know you said it wasn't anything serious, but I'd like you to tell me if something is bothering you. I may be able to help...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, um... I was hoping to give Miku, you and the others some gifts for Valentine's Day...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Gifts? For us...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, because I heard that you're supposed to spend the day giving gifts to those who mean the most to you.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: All of you have helped me so much, so I'd like to give back somehow...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But I've been having so much trouble thinking of what to give...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Then, would you like to make some scented candles with me?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Ms. Mochizuki... I mean, the housekeeper who I have cook and clean... She taught me how to make them earlier.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I can make them on my own now and still have materials left to make some more, so I can teach you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That is, Len, if you'd like me to.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Y-You will? Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Then... P-Please teach me...!
I want to make everyone gifts for Valentine's Day!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, then let's make them together.
Yoisaki Household - Kitchen

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That's about it. How do you feel? Are you ready to make one?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Y-Yeah...! I think...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Don't worry. If you have any questions, I'll be right there to answer them for you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Still, I'm sorry that we couldn't make yours in SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Unfortunately, I don't have any portable stoves in my house.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<N-No, that's okay.
I'm happy just being able to make them with you.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You are? Then, I'll do my best to help you make yours... Again, feel free to ask me for help whenever.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Then, shall we get started...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay, it's changing colors nicely...
We'll mix the wax a little longer, and...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Um... Let it cool, so we can put in the scented oil next...!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh... Yes, that's right.
You have a good memory, Len.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <H-Hehe...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Then, while we give it a chance to cool, why don't we pick out some fragrances?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Okay, umm...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
There's no need to think so hard.
You can just choose the ones you think are nice.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Oh, really...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, but... If you still have trouble deciding, then...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. In that case... Why not choose the ones that you like the most or suit the person receiving your candle?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, um... I was thinking about everyone who'd be receiving my candles, as well as which colors and flowers would suit them best...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You could try thinking about the recipients of your candles.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <The recipients?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes... For example, you could think about what suits them best or will make them smile and such. That may help you find the answer you're looking for.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I see...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And if that still seems a bit too difficult, you can try remembering what everyone's like...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Okay... I'll try that...!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<So, Miku, Rin, Luka, MEIKO...
You and everyone else...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Miku and the others aren't always together... They're separated most of the time, but they're always willing to help me whenever I get lost.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Not just Miku. Rin, Luka, MEIKO...
They're all really nice...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <So are you and the others, Kanade.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Us too...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah... There are times when you look like you're in pain, but you're always doing your best to try and save others...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Which is why I think you're all so kind. And that makes me want to support you in your efforts.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <So... I'd like to choose a gentle fragrance that feels warm and can help cheer you up...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<*Gasp*
I'm sorry. I didn't mean to yammer on like that...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, that's okay...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Still, alright... A warm and gentle fragrance...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It smells sweet... And fruity... Apples?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes, I thought so too at first!
Apparently, it's chamomile, but it really does smell sweet and gentle like the way apples do.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Then, let's try this one.
It's chamomile, but it smells like apples.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It has a sweet and fruity fragrance to it, which I also vaguely think has some warmth to it...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Oh... O-Okay...! That sounds perfect...! I think I'll go with that...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, let's try using it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, it's hardened. Your candle's all done, Len.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Len? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Oh, um... I just thought that it looks really pretty... Also, I'm amazed that it turned out so well...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Now... I can make candles like you and your friends, Kanade...!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, and I'm sure everyone will enjoy your gifts to them...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Kanade... Um... Thanks...
I'm really happy that I have something to give now...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I wouldn't have been able to do anything like this by myself...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, don't say that...
You were able to make this scented candle because you said that you wanted to and put in the effort, Len.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: All I did was help you a little.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Thanks, Kanade...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Um... I really appreciate you teaching me how to make scented candles... And I'm really happy that I got to make one with you...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: With me...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah. I think it's always fun when you get to do stuff like this with someone else.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I agree...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Oh, Kanade, before I forget...!
Please keep what we did today a secret.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Because... I want to surprise everyone with my Valentine's Day gifts.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay... Oh, in that case...
Please keep the fact that I made scented candles for everyone a secret as well.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: My plan is to also surprise them.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <O-Okay...! Then, this will be our little secret.>
